name: Penpot
why: Open-source design and prototyping tool that runs in the browser and can be self-hosted.
coreLoopCovered: Vector design, components and collaboration with export. Built for interface design; no template library or stock assets like Canva.

name: Graphite
why: Open-source vector and raster graphics editor with node-based procedural tools, in the browser and as an app.
coreLoopCovered: Layer-based editing and PNG export. No templates, stock library or team brand kit.

name: Excalidraw
why: Browser whiteboard for hand-drawn style diagrams that exports PNG and SVG.
coreLoopCovered: Quick diagrams and sketches with image export. Not a layout or template tool.

name: tldraw
why: Infinite canvas SDK and whiteboard app for drawing and diagramming.
coreLoopCovered: Freeform canvas with shapes and export. A developer SDK, not a template design tool.

name: Inkscape
why: Open-source desktop vector graphics editor that exports PNG and PDF.
coreLoopCovered: Vector layout with text, layers and PNG/PDF export. Desktop app, no templates, no collaboration, no stock library.

name: Krita
why: Open-source desktop painting and image editing application.
coreLoopCovered: Raster painting and image layers with export. Desktop app aimed at illustration, no templates or collaboration.

name: GIMP
why: Open-source desktop image editor for photo retouching and compositing.
coreLoopCovered: Photo editing, text and layers with PNG/PDF export. Desktop app, no templates or collaboration.
